statement:
∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (c d a : ℝ),
  (Continuous fun p => f p.1 p.2) →
    (Continuous fun p => f' p.1 p.2) →
      (∀ (b x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun b => f b x) (f' b x) b) →
        HasDerivAt (fun b => ∫ (x : ℝ) in c..d, f b x) (∫ (x : ℝ) in c..d, f' a x) a

universal.type: Continuous fun p => f p.1 p.2
universal.name: hf

universal.type: Continuous fun p => f' p.1 p.2
universal.name: hf'

universal.type: ∀ (b x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun b => f b x) (f' b x) b
universal.name: hd

hyps.text: Continuous fun p => f p.1 p.2
hyps.name: hf

hyps.text: Continuous fun p => f' p.1 p.2
hyps.name: hf'

hyps.text: ∀ (b x : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun b => f b x) (f' b x) b
hyps.name: hd

goal.text: HasDerivAt (fun b => ∫ (x : ℝ) in c..d, f b x) (∫ (x : ℝ) in c..d, f' a x) a
